title: Work and Earn in Britain
subtitle: Jobs, contracts, freelancing and finding clients in the United Kingdom
description:
A plain-language guide to working and earning in the United Kingdom, written by the Naara Family.

This first part gives an honest picture of the 2026 job market, explains your right to work and how the check works for your visa, and shows what really lands in your account after pay and tax. Every figure carries the date it was checked, and where a fact could not be confirmed from an official source it says so.

General information, not legal, immigration, tax or financial advice.
